body:
PR #4308 (STORY-2905 S1t-b, base integration 1fa0746) is ready for review at 584b5d5badf. check-ci-fast passed (rc 0), ci:full is labeled and auto-queue-review has run.
The only conflict merging integration (landing_merge.rs) was S1t-a's squash; integration's copy equals the S1t-a branch's final copy, so I kept the S1t-b side. The diff against integration is S1t-b only (5 files).
Contents: landing_merge::train_recheck in VerifiedTrainMerge::enforce before every forge merge attempt. It runs the boundary recheck of the train change under the proof-time landing snapshot (policy, floor lapse, advisor merger with a re-validated grant), C2 per car on the car's own specs, and the stacked-proof base binding (fetched base == proved base, else BehindBase). Manual 'aida pr train' is refused up front where the advisor merges unless run by the advisor or operator. Regressions: train_recheck passes, base moved, policy changed, non-advisor in review-gated.
Promotion 23 (S1c + S1t-a + S1t-b) follows once #4308 is in integration and main is green (you noted main is red at 12264ad, with #4307 fixing forward).
subject: PR-4308 (S1t-b, STORY-2905) ready for review at 584b5d5badf
